label: Todo Management
title: Todo Management
subtitle: Gives agents a structured task list for managing their own work within a session. Agents plan tasks upfront, mark each one in progress, and complete it with a reference to the chat cell that shows the work.
whenToUse: Use when an agent is tackling a complex multi-step task and you want visibility into what it is doing. The todo list is visible in the Project Overview.

methods.name: Plan Tasks
methods.description: Creates a structured list of tasks the agent plans to complete.

methods.name: Start Task
methods.description: Marks a task as in progress.

methods.name: Complete Task
methods.description: Marks a task as done, optionally pointing at the observation cell that evidences the work, so a reader can check the task against what actually happened.

methods.name: Solve Directly
methods.description: Resolves a task quickly without a formal completion note.

methods.name: List Tasks
methods.description: Returns the current state of the task list.

mediaCaption: A Todo list card in the chat showing tasks, their status icons, and the proof links on completed items
